verdict.rationale: Unleash is a feature-flag management platform, not an AI agent or LLM host that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is outside its product role. The documented Unleash MCP server lets coding assistants manage flags, but that is the server role and belongs to a separate story. Nothing in the evidence shows Unleash itself connecting to external MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
